company_summary: Runway is a company that develops foundational multimodal AI models for content generation, with a core product focused on physics-aware AI video-generation models. Recently, the company launched a $10 million fund and startup program to support companies building with its AI video models, and also released its first world model. Runway has raised significant funding, including a $50 million Series C round in December 2022 and a $141 million Series C extension round in June 2023, valuing the company at $1.5 billion. With this funding, the company is pushing towards developing interactive, real-time "video intelligence" applications, although its team size is not mentioned.
